rules.name: DryRunMandatory
rules.description: Actual writes to Kuzu must be disabled by default (allow_write=False).

rules.name: PlanValidation
rules.description: Adapter must validate the structure and safety of the GraphSyncPlan before any action.

rules.name: DegradedOnMissingDB
rules.description: If Kuzu is unavailable, the adapter must return a DEGRADED status instead of failing.
